Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Caris LeVert?

Caris LeVert is 31 years old.

Where was Caris LeVert born?

Caris LeVert was born in Columbus, Ohio.

When was Caris LeVert born?

Caris LeVert was born on August 25, 1994.

How tall is Caris LeVert?

Caris LeVert is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much does Caris LeVert weigh?

Caris LeVert weighs 205 lbs (92 kg).

Is Caris LeVert in the Hall of Fame?

Caris LeVert is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Caris LeVert drafted?

Caris LeVert was drafted by Indiana Pacers, 1st round (20th pick, 20th overall), 2016 NBA Draft.

What position does Caris LeVert play?

Shooting Guard and Small Forward.

What is Caris LeVert's net worth?

Caris LeVert has made at least $106,127,278 playing professional basketball.

How much does Caris LeVert make?

Caris LeVert made $18,796,296 in 2023.

How many rings does Caris LeVert have?

Caris LeVert has won 0 championships.

What is Caris LeVert's Instagram account?

Caris LeVert is on Instagram at carislevert.

What schools did Caris LeVert attend?

Caris LeVert attended Central in Pickerington, Ohio and Michigan.

What are Caris LeVert's nicknames?

Baby Durant is a nickname for Caris LeVert.
